Delete an uploaded file

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    file_id = "file-abc123"
    result = await client.delete_file(file_id)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
